Question_text: Ben travels to work by bus, by bicycle or by car. The probability that he travels by bus on any day is 0.5. The probability that he travels by bicycle on any day is 0.2. The tree diagram below shows some of the probabilities of the possible journeys on Monday and Tuesday.
